LET’S CLEAR A FEW THINGS UP

A few questions.
A little clarity.

About Hello Customer, the planned experience and what to expect before launch.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Simple answers.

Let’s clear a few things up.

What is Hello Customer?

Hello Customer is a customer engagement and marketing platform by SaralKaro for Indian businesses. It brings customer contacts, promotional campaigns and supported WhatsApp Business communication into one mobile-focused experience. AI-assisted creation is planned and not yet available.

Is the app available yet?

Hello Customer is currently under development. Product previews are illustrative concepts, and early-access enquiries do not create an account or begin a free trial.

Do I need marketing experience?

No specialist marketing expertise is intended to be necessary. We’re designing guided workflows for small and growing businesses.

Is this an official WhatsApp or Meta app?

No. Hello Customer is an independent SaralKaro product intended to use supported official WhatsApp Business Platform integrations. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Meta or WhatsApp.

Can I use my existing WhatsApp Business number?

This depends on supported connection methods and Meta eligibility requirements. Account eligibility, verification, template approval and messaging limits are determined by applicable Meta requirements.

Can I message anyone or send unlimited messages?

No. Businesses must have required recipient permission, honour opt-outs, and follow platform rules and applicable laws.

How much does Hello Customer cost?

Hello Customer offers one software subscription priced at ₹399 per month.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Eligible new businesses can start with a one-month free trial. The trial has not started merely because an early-access enquiry was prepared.

Are WhatsApp messaging charges included?

No. Applicable WhatsApp messaging charges are separate from the Hello Customer software subscription and depend on Meta’s applicable pricing and usage.

Can I cancel my subscription?

Yes. Once recurring billing is enabled, you can cancel future subscription renewals through the supported cancellation process.

Can I get a refund?

A refund may be available when requested within five calendar days of the relevant subscription payment, provided no campaign has been run during that paid period.

What happens if I cancel after automatic payment?

You can cancel future renewals. A payment already collected is considered under the applicable five-day refund policy.

How can I request a refund?

Email hellocustomer.support@saralkaro.app with your registered business information and payment reference. Never send a password, OTP or complete card details.

What happens after my free trial ends?

The standard subscription price is ₹399 per month. Any automatic charge requires appropriate payment authorization and clear disclosure of renewal conditions.

Will AI write my messages?

AI-assisted drafting is planned, not currently available. Businesses must review generated content when the feature launches.
